children.game_version: Rhythm matching game using light wooden sticks in pairs.

seniors.seated_version: Perform stick striking movements while seated facing a partner.
seniors.standing_version: Perform stationary stick strikes without rapid direction changes.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Moderate tempo with comfortable arm extensions.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Active extension and control of arms holding wooden sticks for striking
movement_profile.footwork: Rhythmic stepping coordinated with stick strikes
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Group performance space, indoor or outdoor
movement_profile.partnering: Pairs or group interaction where participants strike sticks against each other's sticks
movement_profile.posture: Upright, active stance oriented towards stick striking

signature_moves.description: Rhythmic striking of wooden stick against another participant's stick.
signature_moves.name: Stick strike

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Mishandling sticks during strikes to prevent accidental hand contact.

music_profile.sound_description: The soundscape is defined primarily by the sharp percussive clack of wooden sticks striking together in synchrony.

basic_steps: Hold stick firmly in one or both hands
Step in rhythm towards a partner or neighboring dancer
Strike stick against partner's stick to mark the primary beat
teaching.formation: Group formation facing partners or in circle
teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on clear timing of the stick contact.
